notes: Beta-readiness polish: increases typography throughout Settings/Admin screens, dialogs, forms, manufacturer management and administrative controls.
Guided Firearm Setup can create a missing firearm manufacturer in-place and continue without leaving the wizard.
Manufacturer Administration now saves through the dedicated manufacturer API so catalog edits remain authoritative.
Reports have explicit light and dark theme treatments for tabs, metrics, callouts, tables and print output.
Adds the Windows standalone beta-candidate build path while Docker remains the primary ArmoryGrid deployment.
